card.name: Small words in old travel and history prose
card.fires_on: Small linking words (a, the, this, some, any, even, between, of) and adjective endings in 19th-century-style narrative about geography, scenery, or history. The next word is usually a place feature or a description.

modes.label: Scenery description
modes.description: A small word or adjective ending in a description of landscape such as slopes, ravines, and mountains.
modes.example: as he casts his eye down<< some>> steep slope, or almost unfathomable

modes.label: Place and history
modes.description: A small word inside a sentence locating an ancient city or a military movement.
modes.example: where it breaks through between<< the>> mountains Taurus and Lebanon.

modes.label: Missionary or military narrative
modes.description: A determiner before a nearby object or place in an older narrative.
modes.example: go to<< a>> stream off to the right of the command

card.plain: It fires on little connecting words in old-fashioned travel and history writing about places and landscapes, not on medical text.
